record.enforcement: Official order at onset; actual VTL-land traffic before April 2022 and large-scale clearance on April 1.

record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; current status not inferred.
record.uncertainty: Staged admission regime, not continuous total closure. April endpoint is broad vaccinated access; exemptions and earlier channels mean no single continuous duration.
